runs.narrative:
The subject vehicle was traveling at 64mph in the center eastbound lane on [XXX] near [XXX], having recently passed a pickup truck (vehicle #2) towing a trailer in the right lane.  A large piece of road debris in the right lane caused vehicle #2 to slow and veer onto the right shoulder.  A second piece of large road debris was observed by the subject vehicle's operator ("VO") in the center lane approximately 80 meters ahead of the subject vehicle.  

The VO took control of the truck and began to steer the subject vehicle to the right, but upon seeing vehicle #2 accelerating and re-entering the right lane from the shoulder, the VO instead steered the subject vehicle into the left lane. After passing the debris, the subject vehicle returned to the center lane and continued driving eastbound on the highway.

A post-event review of the subject vehicle's cameras showed an ambulance with its emergency lights off (vehicle #3) was traveling in the left lane to the rear of the subject vehicle as the subject vehicle began entering the left lane.  When the subject vehicle entered the left lane, vehicle #3 maneuvered onto the left shoulder and came to a stop alongside the median.

The subject vehicle made no contact with vehicle #2 or vehicle #3. PlusAI has not been contacted by any road user with regard to this event.

runs.narrative:
On July [XXX], 2026, at approximately 10:54 AM PDT, a MOIA autonomous vehicle ("MOIA AV") was operating in autonomous mode in Beverly Hills, California, with a safety driver in the driver's seat.

The MOIA AV was traveling southbound on [XXX] and completed a left turn onto eastbound [XXX]. As the MOIA AV proceeded eastbound approaching the intersection with [XXX], the automated driving system disengaged. Approximately nine seconds after the disengagement, and with the automated driving system no longer in control, the safety driver allowed the MOIA AV to drift to the right causing the front passenger side of the MOIA AV to make contact with the driver side of a passenger car that was parked and unoccupied at the south curb of [XXX], facing east. The MOIA AV was traveling at approximately 19 mph at the time of contact. At the time of contact, the MOIA AV's automated driving system was not engaged. Following the contact, the safety driver brought the MOIA AV to a controlled stop at the curb ahead of the parked vehicle.

No injuries were reported. The parked vehicle was unoccupied at the time of contact. No airbags deployed. Both vehicles sustained minor damage, and neither vehicle was towed from the scene. Weather conditions were clear, and the roadway surface was dry. The registered owner of the parked vehicle was notified of the collision at the scene and provided appropriate contact and insurance information. Law enforcement was not contacted.

MOIA is reporting this crash under Request No. 2 of Standing General Order 2021-01 because the subject vehicle struck another vehicle, and the automated driving system was engaged within the 30 seconds immediately prior to the crash. MOIA is reviewing the vehicle data and may supplement or correct this report as additional information becomes available.
